headline: As of 2026-10-28: 35,960,124 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+10.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 35,960,124 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+10.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (5,254,876), California (3,595,843), Florida (3,517,750).
